lesson.uz:
Bir necha holatni ajratish uchun Else ichiga yana If joylashtiring. Chegaralarni o‘sish yoki kamayish tartibida tekshiring; barcha holatlarda natija tayinlansin.
Masalan, 90 va yuqori — A; aks holda 70 va yuqori — B; qolganlari — C. 70, 89, 90 kabi chegara qiymatlari bilan qo‘lda sinang. Bitta aniq natija chiqaring.
lesson.en:
Place another If inside Else to distinguish several cases. Test boundaries in order and assign a result in every case.
For example, 90 or above gives A; otherwise 70 or above gives B; the rest gives C. Try boundary values such as 70, 89 and 90. Print one unambiguous result.
